AND AWARD DATED 02.09.2014 PASSED IN MVC NO.501/2012 ON THE FILE OF THE COURT OF SMALL CAUSES AND MOTOR ACCIDENT CLAIMS TRIBUNAL,
AT BANGALORE (SCCH-09) AWARDING COMPENSATION OF RS.1,13,000/- WITH INTEREST @ 6% P.A. FROM THE DATE OF PETITION TILL ITS RELIAZATION.
THIS APPEAL COMING ON FOR CONCILIATION BEFORE NATIONAL LOK ADALAT, THE FOLLOWING CONCILIATION ORDER IS PASSED.
The learned Counsel appearing for the Appellant - Insurance Company has filed a Memo seeking permission to withdraw the above appeal as not pressed.
The said Memo is placed on record.
2. Accordingly, the above appeal is dismissed as withdrawn.
The amount if any, deposited before this Court shall be transferred to the claims Tribunal.

Sd/-
